# Samples

<!-- generated by scripts/samples.mjs; do not edit -->

Every starter of the Studio, printed as your application would print it: a final render of the starter's own synthetic data, which is no customer's,
resolved by `@formancy/report-runtime` at 2026-10-17T08:00:00Z, drawn as a PDF by `@formancy/report-render-pdf` and written as a Word file by
`@formancy/report-render-docx`. A report that carries an e-invoice is written as a Word file from its copy, and its XML is the runtime's of the same render:
the file the e-invoice gate records and has Mustang and KoSIT's validator judge, as it has veraPDF and Mustang judge the Factur-X's PDF.

| Starter | What it shows | PDF | Word | XML |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Service inspection report (`service-inspection`) | long text over pages, a section shown only when a defect exists, a bounded photo from the data, a signature line | [service-inspection.pdf](service-inspection.pdf) | [service-inspection.docx](service-inspection.docx) |  |
| Offerte (`quotation`) | a repeated table header, exact totals with a VAT line and cash rounding, Swiss franc formatting and a page footer | [quotation.pdf](quotation.pdf) | [quotation.docx](quotation.docx) |  |
| Equipment register (`grouped-equipment`) | a stable order, one grouping level headed by its key, a count and sum per group, a grand total and an empty state | [grouped-equipment.pdf](grouped-equipment.pdf) | [grouped-equipment.docx](grouped-equipment.docx) |  |
| Rechnung mit QR-Zahlteil (`invoice`) | a Swiss QR-bill: the receipt and the payment part at the foot of the last page, paying the invoice’s exact total by a QR reference read from the data | [invoice.pdf](invoice.pdf) | [invoice.docx](invoice.docx) |  |
| Rechnung mit SEPA-Zahlcode (`euro-invoice`) | an EPC QR code: a SEPA credit transfer of the invoice’s exact total in euro, by a creditor reference read from the data, beside the payment details it holds, printed in plain text | [euro-invoice.pdf](euro-invoice.pdf) | [euro-invoice.docx](euro-invoice.docx) |  |
| Rechnung (ZUGFeRD) (`e-invoice`) | an EN 16931 e-invoice: its totals and VAT breakdown computed once for the page and the XML, at 19 % and 7 %, with a delivery date, paid by SEPA credit transfer and an EPC code for the amount due | [e-invoice.pdf](e-invoice.pdf): the invoice, a PDF/A-3b that embeds its XML | [e-invoice.docx](e-invoice.docx): a copy, labelled on every page as not the invoice | [e-invoice.xml](e-invoice.xml): the XML its PDF embeds |
| Rechnung (XRechnung) (`e-invoice-xrechnung`) | an XRechnung 3.0 for a German public buyer: its XML the invoice a host takes, its Leitweg-ID the buyer’s reference and its electronic address, and its PDF a copy labelled so on every page | [e-invoice-xrechnung.pdf](e-invoice-xrechnung.pdf): a copy, labelled on every page as not the invoice | [e-invoice-xrechnung.docx](e-invoice-xrechnung.docx): a copy, labelled on every page as not the invoice | [e-invoice-xrechnung.xml](e-invoice-xrechnung.xml): the invoice |
| Site visit (`site-visit`) | a report generated from a formancy form version, which names that version, and a submission of it read into the draft against it | [site-visit.pdf](site-visit.pdf) | [site-visit.docx](site-visit.docx) |  |
| Auftragsbestätigung (`order-confirmation`) | several tables over one list of lines, each picking its lines by their kind and totalling its own; a delivery’s header kept with its first three lines; and a letterhead on page 1 in place of the running header the later pages print | [order-confirmation.pdf](order-confirmation.pdf) | [order-confirmation.docx](order-confirmation.docx) |  |
| Produktdatenblatt (`product-data-sheet`) | values set below and above the line -- a unit’s power, an index and a footnote’s mark -- and one report written in German, French, Italian and English, each printing whole | [product-data-sheet.pdf](product-data-sheet.pdf) | [product-data-sheet.docx](product-data-sheet.docx) |  |
| Mahnung (`payment-reminder`) | two tables over one list of open items, the overdue invoices and what was received against them, each picking its kinds; the balance of every item, the fee among them, paid by a Swiss QR-bill in the language a render names; and a letterhead on page 1 in place of the running header a longer reminder prints from page 2 | [payment-reminder.pdf](payment-reminder.pdf) | [payment-reminder.docx](payment-reminder.docx) |  |
| Umsatzbericht (`sales-report`) | a bar chart and a pie chart of the detail rows beside a table of the same rows grouped by the bar chart’s category, each bar’s label the total its group prints and each slice’s share its region’s total over the month’s, rounded once; and a letterhead on page 1 in place of the running header the later pages print | [sales-report.pdf](sales-report.pdf) | [sales-report.docx](sales-report.docx) |  |

`node scripts/samples.mjs --write` writes this folder from the packages as built, after `pnpm build`. `pnpm test:repo` fails when a file here is not
what the current build writes: this page, each Word file and each XML byte for byte, and each PDF by its objects with every stream inflated, since
PDFKit deflates them with the zlib of the Node it runs on, and another zlib may write the same document in other bytes
([0079](../docs/decisions/0079-every-starters-pdf-and-word-file-are-committed-as-samples-held-to-the-build-and-the-readme-draws-every-package-in-a-sketch.md)). Lines and pages in a Word file are Word's to lay out, and no test opens one in Word.
